title: Marketplace Details — should its outer header match?

steps.hint: Scroll inside the skill content, then scroll outside it to compare Today and Proposed. Try both at the top and bottom.
steps.headline: Which outer header and scroll edge works for a skill?
steps.risk: The skill data is a Workbench sample. The proposal changes only the outer Details header and scroll edge; the large skill name, trust line and actions remain as they are. No production detail styling changed.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: 18px semibold Details header, full-width divider and bare scrolling body.

variants.label: Matching edge
variants.summary: 16px medium Details header, 8% tapered line and unpainted 42px/4%-side content fade where scroll room remains.

steps.hint: Compare the outer Details header above the theme name. Scroll inside the theme body; its edge fades only if more content is hidden.
steps.headline: Should the theme Details popup get the same outer header?
steps.risk: Theme details use a Workbench registry fixture with its preview image. Applying a theme, installing and voting are not under review; no production detail styling changed.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Existing 18px semibold Details header and full-width divider.

variants.label: Matching edge
variants.summary: 16px medium Details header and 8% tapered line; content fade only if the body overflows.
